code:
No alert blinking.
No executive asking for updates.
No clock running.

That calm is the whole point.
caption: Preparation is the only time a SOC builds its IR capability deliberately, instead of improvising under pressure.

eyebrow: Three things that must exist first

steps.label: Written Plan
steps.sub: decision authority and severity levels, on paper

steps.label: Trained Team
steps.sub: tabletop exercises, clear roles, before day one

steps.label: Ready Tools & Access
steps.sub: credentials and tooling already provisioned and tested

code:
Incident starts.
Team needs to isolate a compromised server.
Nobody has the admin credentials --
the prior admin left two months ago.

That is a Preparation failure, not a Detection failure.
caption: Scrambling for access during an incident costs time in the one phase where time matters most.
